test_eigen_fixed_matrix_bindings: test pybind11 Eigen fixed-size matrix bindings by calling fixed_c and fixed_r and comparing with numpy reference arrays
test_eigen_dense_matrix_bindings: test pybind11 Eigen dynamic-size matrix bindings by calling dense_r and dense_c and comparing with numpy reference arrays
test_eigen_mutator_descriptors: test Eigen mutator descriptors by passing row-major and column-major numpy arrays and verifying TypeError on mismatched contiguity
test_eigen_return_references: test Eigen return reference semantics by creating a ReturnTester and verifying owndata and writeable flags on get, view, copy, ref, block, and corners methods
test_eigen_sparse_matrix_bindings: test pybind11 Eigen sparse matrix bindings by calling sparse_r and sparse_c and comparing with scipy sparse reference arrays
